Return $\widehat z\in K$. Any measurable postprocessing of the history is permitted, including an unqueried point, an average, or a convex combination, subject only to the stated output domain and feasibility conditions. No extra function value or computable certificate is required.
The set $K\subset\mathbb R^d$ is known, nonempty, compact, and convex, with $\operatorname{diam}(K)\le D_K$. The operator $F=n^{-1}\sum_iF_i$ is monotone; components need not be monotone.

norms.definition: Use the Euclidean vector norm $\|v\|_2=(\sum_jv_j^2)^{1/2}$ and inner product $\langle u,v\rangle=\sum_j u_jv_j$.
